summary: This is a clipped web page from the online shop Peace With The Wild (peacewiththewild.co.uk), despite the file title 'greetingcards'. Almost all of the captured text is site navigation: a long menu of product categories, including skincare, haircare, makeup, bathroom, kitchen, home, travel, baby, food and gift items. The note contains no greeting card products or card text, and it is cut off partway through the skincare subcategory list.
one_line: Navigation-heavy clipping from the Peace With The Wild online shop's product category menus, with no greeting card content.
